title: Eurostat Electricity Prices for Household Consumers
description: Semi-annual electricity prices for household consumers across European countries by consumption band, tax component, and currency, Eurostat table nrg_pc_204. Non-geospatial companion table, join key is the country code column geo (NUTS-0), converted to cloud-native Parquet.

table:columns.name: DATAFLOW
table:columns.description: Eurostat dataflow identifier, the constant ESTAT nrg_pc_204 version 1.0.

table:columns.name: LAST UPDATE
table:columns.description: Frozen at one 2019 timestamp for every row of this snapshot while the data runs to 2025. Unreliable, do not derive freshness from it.

table:columns.name: freq
table:columns.description: Observation frequency, the constant S for semi-annual. S1 is January to June, S2 is July to December.

table:columns.name: siec
table:columns.description: Energy product code, the constant E7000 for electricity.

table:columns.name: nrg_cons
table:columns.description: Annual consumption band. KWH_LT1000, KWH1000-2499, KWH2500-4999 the headline household band, KWH5000-14999, KWH_GE15000, and TOT_KWH the weighted all-band average that exists only from 2017-S2.

table:columns.name: unit
table:columns.description: Unit of measure, the constant KWH. Prices are per kilowatt-hour.

table:columns.name: tax
table:columns.description: Tax level. X_TAX excludes all taxes and levies, X_VAT excludes VAT and recoverable taxes, I_TAX includes everything a household pays.

table:columns.name: currency
table:columns.description: EUR, NAC for national currency, or PPS purchasing power standard. NAC equals EUR in the euro area.

table:columns.name: geo
table:columns.description: Reporting country as a Eurostat NUTS-0 code, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 except EL for Greece and UK for the United Kingdom, plus the aggregates EU27_2020 and EA. The join key to a geometry Collection.

table:columns.name: TIME_PERIOD
table:columns.description: Reference semester as a string, 2025-S2. Fixed format, so string ordering and MAX work.

table:columns.name: OBS_VALUE
table:columns.description: The observed electricity price in the stated currency per kilowatt-hour.

table:columns.name: OBS_FLAG
table:columns.description: Observation status, e estimated, p provisional, d definition differs, null for 98 percent of rows.

table:columns.name: CONF_STATUS
table:columns.description: Confidentiality status, entirely null in this snapshot.

data.title: Eurostat Electricity Prices for Household Consumers (Parquet)
